## Documentation as Institutional Memory

This documentation serves as a **Cognitive Build Ledger** - a complete longitudinal record of the system's evolution:

- **919 session handoffs** preserve decisions, bugs, fixes, and lessons learned
- **71 audits** document system reality vs. expectations
- **Design docs** capture architectural intent and the "why"
- Any AI agent can resume work without loss of context

**Philosophy:** Document while thinking, not after building.

## Frontmatter Schema (Optional)

New documents can include YAML frontmatter for richer metadata:

```yaml
---
subsystems: [agents, frontend, api]
decision_types: [feature, bug_fix]
status: active  # active|superseded|deprecated|draft
see_also: [SESSION_123_RELATED.md]
supersedes: SESSION_100_OLD.md
---
```

## Quick Start

```bash
# 1. Read current session context
cat 00-START-NEXT-SESSION.md

# 2. Start platform
make start && make celery

# 3. Access UI
open http://localhost:8000/ai-studio/

# 4. Regenerate this index
python manage.py build_docs_index
```
